versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00178 The Rte_NvMNotifyJobFinished API shall be executed in the EcucPartition referenced by NvMBlockDescriptor . NvMBlockEcucPartitionRef .

The Rte_NvMNotifyJobFinished API shall be executed in the EcucPartition referenced by the associated NvBlockDescriptor 's NvMBlock- EcucPartitionRef parameter. If this parameter does not exist, the Rte_NvMNo- tifyJobFinished API shall be executed in the EcucPartition referenced by the ECUC parameter EcucDefaultBswPartition .
